tool_description: Survey search over catalog entries. Returns EVERY entry lexically matching your terms (word-prefix match, uncapped), plus up to semantic_n flagged semantic suggestions for concepts phrased differently. Expand your query into synonyms and related terms (e.g. "ocr" -> ["ocr", "text extraction", "document to markdown", "handwriting recognition"]) and pass them as terms; omitting terms treats the whole query as one all-tokens-must-match lookup term. Response reports per-term hit counts (swept_terms) and lexical_total — lexical_total 0 means an honest miss. Filters: decision_status, category.
prompt:
You are about to call the catalog search tool described below to answer the brief. Write the query and terms you would send.

TOOL:

Survey search over catalog entries. Returns EVERY entry lexically matching your terms (word-prefix match, uncapped), plus up to semantic_n flagged semantic suggestions for concepts phrased differently. Expand your query into synonyms and related terms (e.g. "ocr" -> ["ocr", "text extraction", "document to markdown", "handwriting recognition"]) and pass them as terms; omitting terms treats the whole query as one all-tokens-must-match lookup term. Response reports per-term hit counts (swept_terms) and lexical_total — lexical_total 0 means an honest miss. Filters: decision_status, category.

LIMITS: query <= 2000 chars; terms: up to 50, each 1-200 chars.

BRIEF:

I build a tool that dispatches coding agents to run tasks in the background. I want a live view of the agents while they work, like zoetrope (I think that's the name): who is running, what they are doing, and when one hangs. A terminal view or a web page both work. What do we have?
